description: Stores the pages of the in-game tutorial/help popup: which tutorial flow each page belongs to, its heading and message keys, and the explanation images (including keyboard/controller-specific variants) shown beside the text.

Id.technical: FName export key (export field ID, import key Id). The row’s own Id is not read by the reconstructed runtime. FGameDataTableArray::GetRows collects pointers in table order and then UDataTable row-name order; ShowTutorialTypes filters only on TutorialWidgetType and appends each matching row, so row names establish page order within a requested type. The single export shard has 54 unique row keys.

TutorialWidgetType.simple: Tutorial flow/category this page belongs to.
TutorialWidgetType.technical: EGameTutorialWidgetType (uint8): None=0, Move=1 through Adapt=38 as contiguous values, and Invalid=255 as a sentinel. The row constructor defaults this field to None. ShowTutorial(Type) forwards a one-element list to ShowTutorialTypes; for each requested type in list order, that function scans the cached rows and appends the matches. All 38 named non-None/non-Invalid values occur in the export, and some types contribute several pages; no None or Invalid row is exported.

Id_TutorialLabel.simple: Localized heading shown at the top of the page.
Id_TutorialLabel.technical: FName heading key passed unchanged to HeaderText->SetTextIdOnly on every SetPage call. The text block builds an FGameTextRequest and resolves it through AGameTextManager; the exported TUT_* keys are not SYS_* IDs and are present in TutorialTextDataTable_<Language>, one of the GameText tables loaded into the text manager’s language cache. No COUNT/MAX parameters are attached to the heading.

Id_TutorialMessage.simple: Localized body text for the tutorial page.
Id_TutorialMessage.technical: FName body key passed to ExplanationText_1 when either texture slot is non-None, or to ExplanationText_2 when slots 0 and 1 are both None. The sole exported row using TUT_OUTGAME_MESSAGE_1301 (TUT_WIDGET_OUTGAME_1301) is rewritten to TUT_OUTGAME_MESSAGE_1304 at display time; all other 53 rows pass through unchanged. Both keys are present in all 11 TutorialTextDataTable_<Language> export shards.

TutorialTextureName.simple: Ordered list of explanation image names for the page.
TutorialTextureName.technical: TArray<FName> with exactly two slots in every exported row; 24 of those 108 slots are None. The loader skips None, then uses the same-index switch flag to create bare-FName WidgetTexture primary-asset loaders (false) or direct Win64 streamable paths (true). SetPage reads indices 0 and 1 unguarded: both None selects Layout_2/ExplanationText_2, otherwise Layout_1/ExplanationText_1. ApplyPageTextures walks the row’s non-None names in order and the two ExplanationImages, applying only names that have a loaded texture; a missing earlier texture is skipped rather than reserving its image slot.

bSwitchPlatformTutorialTexture.simple: Parallel flags selecting input-device-specific image variants.
bSwitchPlatformTutorialTexture.technical: TArray<bool> parallel to TutorialTextureName; every exported row has two flags. After a None name is skipped, the loader reads bSwitchPlatformTutorialTexture[Index] without a bounds check. true loads /Game/Widgets/StreamingAssets/Tutorial/Win64/<Name>_Win64_Keyboard.<Name>_Win64_Keyboard and the matching _Controller object through LoadAssetList; false creates a WidgetTexture primary-asset loader keyed by the bare FName and resolved through the asset-manager cache. ApplyPageTextures removes _Win64 from loaded object names; EGameWidgetInputGuideType::Keyboard selects the _Keyboard asset, while every other guide type selects _Controller. Seven exported rows contain at least one true flag (10 true slots).

notes: The single export shard contains 54 DataTable rows and uses ImportKeyField Id; all 54 row keys are unique. Every row has exactly two entries in each parallel array (24 texture-name slots are None; 10 switch slots are true). Keep the arrays aligned and at least two long: SetPage reads indices 0 and 1 unchecked, and the loader indexes the switch array by texture index.

The only C++ row reader found is UGameTutorialWidget: DataTable primary asset TutorialWidgetDataTable -> DataTableLoaders -> manager cache TutorialWidgetDataTables -> FGameDataTableArray::GetRows (table order, then row-name order) -> per-type filtering. Callers supply the requested type list and gate when to show it (config menus, mode phases, mission tutorial steps); page order is requested-type order followed by export row-name order. The table stores no prerequisite or visibility-gating flags.

TUT_* label/message fields are localized text keys, not display strings. AGameTextManager searches its language-specific GameText table cache, which includes TutorialTextDataTable_<Language>, for non-SYS_ IDs. The fixed page counter uses SYS_COMMON_LABEL_0101 with COUNT=CurrentPage+1 (1-based) and MAX=Rows.Num(); those values are generated in SetPage and are not table fields.

The Win64 directory and _Win64_Keyboard / _Win64_Controller suffixes are hard-coded in the reconstructed retail flow. No other platform path, texture-asset existence, or cooked-loader behavior is inferred from this table.

Only the supplied retail DataTable exports and partial Content are available. No retail Blueprint decompilation or editor inspection was performed, so no claim is made about every Blueprint, editor tool, or uncaptured runtime use.

usages.detail: Registers TutorialWidgetDataTable as a DataTable primary asset for the initial loader batch.
After all loaders complete, resolves the loaded UDataTable and appends it (if non-null) to the TutorialWidgetDataTables cache.
Collects typed rows in table order then row-name order; GameTutorialWidget.cpp:78 uses this for TutorialWidgetDataTables.
ShowTutorialTypes keeps rows whose type is in the caller’s list, appends them in requested-type order, and starts the appropriate texture loads.
SetPage applies the row’s label/message keys, chooses the image or text-only layout, and updates 1-based page/count text and navigation buttons.
Creates WidgetTexture loaders for non-platform texture names and a separate Win64 streamable handle for switched names.
ApplyPageTextures maps the current page’s loaded keyboard/controller textures onto the two explanation image widgets.
Caches TutorialTextDataTable_<Language> with the other GameText tables that resolve the row’s TUT_* keys.
Help/Tutorial menus hard-code tutorial-type values (for example 17-37) as button payloads; these select types, not row IDs.
Mission tutorial steps pass an authored EGameTutorialWidgetType list in order; an empty list skips the tutorial popup.
